newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open flat to 0.20 lower.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open flat to 0.20 lower.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open unchanged to 0.20 cent per lb weaker on Monday, based on market orders at 1017 EDT, dealers said.
Friday's weak technical close is expected to prompt follow-through selling, which could pressure the July contract to nearby support pegged at 72.00 cents.

The benchmark July contract finished 1.11 cents lower at 72.45 cents per lb on Friday, having ranged from 73.50 to 72.40 cents. New-crop December closed 0.58 cent weaker at 75.03 cents, while the rest of the board settled 0.80 to 0.50 cent lower.
